# The tools of Linear's hosted MCP server that Linear names in public, from linear.app/changelog. linear.app/docs/mcp lists none,
# so the rest of its tools are not here. save_issue, get_issue, list_issue_statuses and list_users are the ones Firefight's
# issue sync calls (Integrations::IssueTrackers::Linear).
# Each line is a tool as its server names it and whether it only reads or changes something.

list_teams read

list_projects read
get_project read
list_comments read
save_issue change
